verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה בְּטוּרָא דְסִינַי לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe on Mount Sinai, saying;

verses.he: מַלֵּיל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְתֵימַר לְהוֹן אֲרֵי תֵעֲלוּן לְאַרְעָא דִּי אֲנָא יָהֵב לְכוֹן וְתַשְׁמֵט אַרְעָא שְׁמִטְּתָא קֳדָם יְיָ:
verses.en: Speak to Bnei Yisroel and say to them, when you come to the land which I give to you the land shall be at rest—a Shabbos for [rest before] Adonoy.

verses.he: שִׁית שְׁנִין תִּזְרַע חַקְלָךְ וְשִׁית שְׁנִין תִּכְסַח כַּרְמָךְ וְתִכְנוֹשׁ יָת עֲלַלְתַּהּ:
verses.en: For six years you shall plant your field and for six years you shall prune your vineyard and you shall harvest its produce.

verses.he: וּבְשַׁתָּא שְׁבִיעֲתָא נְיַח שְׁמִטְּתָא יְהֵי לְאַרְעָא דְּתַשְׁמֵט קֳדָם יְיָ חַקְלָךְ לָא תִזְרַע וְכַרְמָךְ לָא תִכְסָח:
verses.en: But the seventh year shall be a Shabbos of [complete] rest for the land, a Shabbos for [rest before] Adonoy, you shall not plant your field and you shall not prune your vineyard.

verses.he: יָת כַּתֵּי דַחֲצָדָךְ לָא תֶחֱצַד וְיָת עִנְּבֵי שִׁבְקָךְ לָא תִקְטוֹף שְׁנַת שְׁמִטְּתָא יְהֵי לְאַרְעָא:
verses.en: [Even] crops that grew on their own [from the seeds of your previous] harvest you shall not reap, and the grapes of your untended vines you shall not gather; it shall be a year of complete rest for the land.

verses.he: וּתְהֵי שְׁמִטַּת אַרְעָא לְכוֹן לְמֵיכַל לָךְ וּלְעַבְדָּךְ וּלְאַמְתָךְ וְלַאֲגִירָךְ וּלְתוֹתָבָךְ דְּדָיְרִין עִמָּךְ:
verses.en: The [produce] [rest] of the lands Shabbos[-year] [land] shall be for yourselves, for food, for you, your servant and your maidservant, for your hired hand and your resident sojourner who reside with you.

verses.he: וְלִבְעִירָךְ וּלְחַיְתָא דִּי בְאַרְעָךְ תְּהֵי כָל עֲלַלְתַּהּ לְמֵיכָל:
verses.en: [Also] for your domesticated animals and for the [wild] beasts that are in your land shall all of its produce be for food.

verses.he: וְתִמְנֵי לָךְ שְׁבַע שְׁמִטִּין דִּשְׁנִין שְׁבַע שְׁנִין שְׁבַע זִמְנִין וִיהוֹן לָךְ יוֹמֵי שְׁבַע שְׁמִטִּין דִּשְׁנִין אַרְבְּעִין וְתֵשַׁע שְׁנִין:
verses.en: You shall count for yourself seven sabbatical years [of rest], seven years, seven times and it shall be for you, the days (period) of the seven sabbatical years [of rest], forty-nine years.

verses.he: וְתַעֲבַר שׁוֹפַר יַבָּבָא בְּיַרְחָא שְׁבִיעָאָה בְּעַשְׂרָא לְיַרְחָא בְּיוֹמָא דְכִפּוּרַיָּא תַּעַבְּרוּן שׁוֹפָרָא בְּכָל אַרְעֲכוֹן:
verses.en: You shall make a proclamation [crying] with the shofor on the tenth day of the seventh month. On Yom Kippur shall this shofor-proclamation be made. throughout all your land.

verses.he: וּתְקַדְּשׁוּן יָת שְׁנַת חַמְשִׁין שְׁנִין וְתַקְרוּן חֵרוּתָא בְּאַרְעָא לְכָל יָתְבָהָא יוֹבֵלָא הִיא תְּהֵי לְכוֹן וּתְתוּבוּן גְּבַר לְאַחֲסַנְתֵּיהּ וּגְבַר לְזַרְעִיתֵיהּ תְּתוּבוּן:
verses.en: You shall sanctify the year of the fiftieth year and proclaim freedom in the land for all of its inhabitants; it shall be for you a jubilee and each man shall return to his ancestral land and each man shall return to his family.

verses.he: יוֹבֵלָא הִיא שְׁנַת חַמְשִׁין שְׁנִין תְּהֵי לְכוֹן לָא תִזְרְעוּן וְלָא תַחְצְדוּן יָת כַּתָּהָא וְלָא תִקְטְפוּן יָת שִׁבְקָהָא:
verses.en: It is a jubilee, [that] the year of the fiftieth year shall be for you. You shall not plant and you shall not reap [even] crops that grew on their own; and you shall not gather the [grapes of] its untended vineyard,

verses.he: אֲרֵי יוֹבֵלָא הִיא קוּדְשָׁא תְהֵי לְכוֹן מִן חַקְלָא תֵּיכְלוּן יָת עֲלַלְתַּהּ:
verses.en: For it is a jubilee, it shall be holy to you. Whatever is in the field, you may eat of its produce.

verses.he: בְּשַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא הָדָא תְּתוּבוּן גְּבַר לְאַחֲסַנְתֵּיהּ:
verses.en: On this jubilee year, each man shall return to his ancestral land.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי תְזַבֵּן זְבִינִין לְחַבְרָךְ אוֹ תִזְבֵּן מִידָא דְחַבְרָךְ לָא תוֹנוּן גְּבַר יָת אֲחוֹהִי:
verses.en: If you sell anything to your neighbor, or purchase [something] from your neighbor, do not cheat one another.

verses.he: בְּמִנְיַן שְׁנַיָּא בָּתַר יוֹבֵלָא תִּזְבֵּן מִן חַבְרָךְ בְּמִנְיַן שְׁנֵי עֲלַלְתָּא יְזַבֶּן לָךְ:
verses.en: According to the number of years after the jubilee you shall purchase [land] from your neighbor; according to the number of produce years he shall sell it to you.

verses.he: לְפוּם סְגִיאוּת שְׁנַיָּא תַּסְגֵּי זְבִינוֹהִי וּלְפוּם זְעֵרוּת שְׁנַיָּא תַּזְעֵר זְבִינוֹהִי אֲרֵי מִנְיַן עֲלַלְתָּא הוּא מְזַבֵּן לָךְ:
verses.en: Based on the abundance of years, you shall increase its purchase price and based on the lack of years you shall decrease its purchase price, since it is the number of produce-seasons that he is selling to you.

verses.he: וְלָא תוֹנוּן גְּבַר יָת חַבְרֵיהּ וְתִדְחַל מֵאֱלָהָךְ אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: You shall not cheat one another, and you shall fear your God for I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: וְתַעְבְּדוּן יָת קְיָמַי וְיָת דִּינַי תִּטְּרוּן וְתַעְבְּדוּן יָתְהוֹן וְתֵיתְבוּן עַל אַרְעָא לְרָחְצָן:
verses.en: You shall fulfill My statutes and keep My laws and fulfill them, and you will then live in the land in security.

verses.he: וְתִתֵּן אַרְעָא אִבַּהּ וְתֵיכְלוּן לְמִשְׂבָּע וְתֵיתְבוּן לְרָחֲצָן עֲלַהּ:
verses.en: The land will give forth its fruit and you will eat your fill, and you will live securely on it.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי תֵימְרוּן מָא נֵיכוּל בְּשַׁתָּא שְׁבִיעֵתָא הָא לָא נִזְרָע וְלָא נִכְנוֹשׁ יָת עֲלַלְתָּנָא:
verses.en: If you shall say (ask) What will we eat in the seventh year, for lo! we have not planted nor gathered our produce?

verses.he: וֶאֱפַקֵּד יָת בִּרְכָתִי לְכוֹן בְּשַׁתָּא שְׁתִיתֵתָא וְתַעְבֵּד יָת עֲלַלְתָּא לִתְלַת שְׁנִין:
verses.en: I shall command (direct) My blessing to you in the sixth year and it will produce [enough] for three years.

verses.he: וְתִזְרְעוּן יָת שַׁתָּא תְמִינֵתָא וְתֵיכְלוּן מִן עֲלַלְתָּא עַתִּיקָא עַד שַׁתָּא תְשִׁיעֵתָא עַד מֵעַל עֲלַלְתַּהּ תֵּיכְלוּן עַתִּיקָא:
verses.en: You shall plant in the eighth year but you will still be eating from the old produce until the ninth year; until the [new] produce arrives (ripens) you shall eat [from] the old.

verses.he: וְאַרְעָא לָא תִזְדַּבַּן לַחֲלוּטִין אֲרֵי דִילִי אַרְעָא אֲרֵי דַיָּרִין וְתוֹתָבִין אַתּוּן קֳדָמַי:
verses.en: The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is Mine, for, you are [merely as] foreigners [foreign resident] and resident aliens [residents] before Me.

verses.he: וּבְכֹל אַרְעָא אַחֲסַנְתְּכוֹן פֻּרְקָנָא תִּתְּנוּן לְאַרְעָא:
verses.en: In all of your ancestral lands you shall grant redemption to the land.

verses.he: אֲרֵי יְתְמַסְכַּן אָחוּךְ וִיזַבֵּן מֵאַחֲסַנְתֵּהּ וְיֵיתֵי פָרִיקֵיהּ דְּקָרִיב לֵיהּ וְיִפְרוֹק יָת זְבִינֵי אֲחוּהִי:
verses.en: If your brother becomes impoverished and sells some of his ancestral land, and a close relative comes and redeems that which his brother sold.

verses.he: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי לָא יְהֵי לֵהּ פָּרִיק וְתַדְבֵּק יְדֵהּ וְיַשְׁכַּח כְּמִסַּת פֻּרְקָנֵהּ:
verses.en: [Or] if the man has no redeemer (close relative) but has acquired sufficient means and finds [it] enough to redeem it [himself],

verses.he: וִיחַשֵּׁב יָת שְׁנֵי זְבִינוֹהִי וְיָתֵב יָת מוֹתָרָא לִגְבַר דִּי זַבֶּן לֵיהּ וִיתוּב לְאַחֲסַנְתֵּהּ:
verses.en: He shall calculate the number of years for which he sold the land and return the remainder (excess) to the man to whom he had sold it, and he shall return to his ancestral land.

verses.he: וְאִם לָא תַשְׁכַּח יְדֵהּ כְּמִסַּת אֲתֵב לֵיהּ וִיהֵי זְבִינוֹהִי בִּידָא דִּזְבַן יָתֵיהּ עַד שַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא וְיִפּוֹק בְּיוֹבֵלָא וִיתוּב לְאַחֲסַנְתֵּיהּ:
verses.en: Or if he does not have within his means enough to retrieve the land to himself, then that which he sold remains in the possession of the buyer until the jubilee year. It is then released by the jubilee and he [the seller] returns to his ancestral land.

verses.he: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יְזַבֵּן בֵּית מוֹתַב קַרְתָּא מַקְּפָא שׁוּר וּתְהֵי פֻרְקָנֵיהּ עַד מִשְׁלַם שַׁתָּא דִזְבִינוֹהִי עִדָּן בְּעִדָּן תְּהֵי פֻרְקָנֵיהּ:
verses.en: If a man shall sell a residential home [that is] within [surrounded by] a walled city, the time allotted for its redemption shall be until the end of one year after he sold it. He has the days [of a full year] in which to redeem it.

verses.he: וְאִם לָא יִתְפָּרַק עַד מִשְׁלַם לֵיהּ שַׁתָּא שְׁלֶמְתָּא וִיקוּם בֵּיתָא דִי בְקַרְתָּא דִּי לֵיהּ שׁוּרָא לַחֲלוּטִין לְדִי זְבַן יָתֵיהּ לְדָרוֹהִי לָא יִפּוֹק בְּיוֹבֵלָא:
verses.en: If he does not redeem it by the end of a full year, the house within the city that is surrounded by a wall shall then remain in perpetuity to its purchaser for his generations (descendants.) It is not released by the jubilee.

verses.he: וּבָתֵּי פַצְחַיָּא דִּי לֵית לְהוֹן שׁוּר מַקַּף סְחוֹר סְחוֹר עַל חֲקַל אַרְעָא יִתְחַשָּׁב פֻּרְקָנָא תְּהֵי לֵיהּ וּבְיוֹבֵלָא יִפּוֹק:
verses.en: The houses of open cities which are not surrounded by a [an encircling] wall shall be considered as a field of the land. It shall have a redemption and it is released by the jubilee.

verses.he: וְקִרְוֵי לֵיוָאֵי בָּתֵּי קִרְוֵי אַחֲסַנְתְּהוֹן פֻּרְקַן עָלָם תְּהֵי לְלֵיוָאֵי:
verses.en: The cities of the Levites the houses in the cities of their ancestral land, the Levites shall have an eternal right of redemption.

verses.he: וְדִי יִפְרוֹק מִן לֵיוָאֵי וְיִפּוֹק זְבִין בֵּיתָא וְקַרְתָּא אַחֲסַנְתֵּיהּ בְּיוֹבֵלָא אֲרֵי בָתֵּי קִרְוֵי לֵיוָאֵי הִיא אַחֲסַנְתְּהוֹן בְּגוֹ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל:
verses.en: If anyone redeems [a house or field] from the Levites, then the house or his ancestral city shall be released by the jubilee, for the houses of the Levitic cities are [considered] their ancestral lands among Bnei Yisroel.

verses.he: וַחֲקַל רְוַח קִרְוֵיהוֹן לָא יִזְדַּבָּן אֲרֵי אַחֲסָנַת עָלָם הוּא לְהוֹן:
verses.en: The field on the outskirts of their cities may not be sold for it is their perpetual ancestral land.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי יִתְמַסְכַּן אָחוּךְ וּתְמוּט יְדֵיהּ עִמָּךְ וְתַתְקֵף בֵּיהּ דַּיַּר וְתוֹתָב וִיחֵי עִמָּךְ:
verses.en: If your brother becomes impoverished and his hand (assets) become shaky among you, you must support him, [so too] the proselyte [foreign resident] and the sojourner, [so] that he shall live with you.

verses.he: לָא תִסַּב מִנֵּיהּ חִבּוּלְיָא וְרִבִּיתָא וְתִדְחַל מֵאֱלָהָךְ וִיחֵי אָחוּךְ עִמָּךְ:
verses.en: You shall not take from him interest or usury and you shall fear your God, and your brother shall live with you.

verses.he: יָת כַּסְפָּךְ לָא תִתֵּן לֵיהּ בְּחִבּוּלְיָא וּבְרִבִּיתָא לָא תִתֵּן מֵיכְלָךְ:
verses.en: You must not give (lend) him your money with interest, and usuriously you must not advance him your food.

verses.he: אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן דִּי אַפֵּקִית יָתְכוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם לְמִתַּן לְכוֹן יָת אַרְעָא דִכְנַעַן לְמֶהֱוֵי לְכוֹן לֶאֱלָהּ:
verses.en: I am Adonoy your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, to be a God for you.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי יִתְמַסְכַּן אָחוּךְ עִמָּךְ וְיִזְדַּבַּן לָךְ לָא תִפְלַח בֵּיהּ פָּלְחַן עַבְדִּין:
verses.en: If your brother becomes impoverished and is sold to you, you must not work him like a slave [slaves].

verses.he: כַּאֲגִירָא כְתוֹתָבָא יְהֵי עִמָּךְ עַד שַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא יִפְלַח עִמָּךְ:
verses.en: Like a hired hand or resident [worker] shall he be with you He shall serve you until the jubilee year.

verses.he: וְיִפּוֹק מֵעִמָּךְ הוּא וּבְנוֹהִי עִמֵּיהּ וִיתוּב לְזַרְעִיתֵיהּ וּלְאַחֲסָנַת אֲבָהָתוֹהִי יְתוּב:
verses.en: Then he and his children shall depart from you and return to his own family. He shall return to his ancestral estate.

verses.he: אֲרֵי עַבְדַּי אִנּוּן דִּי אַפֵּקִית יָתְהוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם לָא יִזְדַּבְּנוּן זְבוּן עַבְדִּין:
verses.en: For they are My servants, whom I brought out from the land of Egypt, they shall not be sold [in the market] as slaves.

verses.he: לָא תִפְלַח בֵּיהּ בְּקַשְׁיוּ וְתִדְחַל מֵאֱלָהָךְ:
verses.en: You must not rule over him [make him work] to crush him and you shall fear your God.

verses.he: וְעַבְדָּךְ וְאַמְתָךְ דִּי יְהוֹן לָךְ מִן עַמְמַיָּא דִּי בְסַחֲרָנֵיכוֹן מִנְּהוֹן תִּקְנוּן עַבְדִּין וְאַמְהָן:
verses.en: Your slaves and maidservants that you shall possess from the nations that surround you, from them you may purchase slaves and maidservants.

verses.he: וְאַף מִבְּנֵי תוֹתָבַיָּא עָרְלַיָּא דְּדָיְרִין עִמְּכוֹן מִנְּהוֹן תִּקְנוּן וּמִזַּרְעִיתְהוֹן דְּעִמְּכוֹן דִּי אִתְיְלִידוּ בְּאַרְעֲכוֹן וִיהוֹן לְכוֹן לְאַחֲסָנָא:
verses.en: Also, from the children of the [uncircumcised] sojourners who reside with you from them you may purchase [slaves], and from their families that live among you that were born in your land. [All these] shall be your permanent possession.

verses.he: וְתַחְסְנוּן יָתְהוֹן לִבְנֵיכוֹן בַּתְרֵיכוֹן לִירוּתַת אַחֲסָנָא לְעָלָם בְּהוֹן תִּפְלְחוּן וּבְאַחֵיכוֹן בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל גְּבַר בַּאֲחוּהִי לָא תִפְלַח בֵּיהּ בְּקַשְׁיוּ:
verses.en: You shall will them as inheritance to your children after you as hereditary property; you shall keep them in servitude permanently. However regarding your bretheren, Bnei Yisroel, man over his brother, you must not rule over him [make him work] to crush him.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי תַדְבֵּק יַד עָרֵל וְתוֹתָב עִמָּךְ וְיִתְמַסְכַּן אָחוּךְ עִמֵּיהּ וְיִזְדַּבַּן לְעָרֵל תּוֹתָב עִמָּךְ אוֹ לְאַרְמַי זַרְעִית גִּיּוֹרָא:
verses.en: If a foreigner [an uncircumcised one] or resident acquires means while your brother becomes impoverished by him, and is sold to a [an uncircumcised] resident foreigner who resides with you or to the offspring [a non-Jew] of a foreign [proselyte] family.

verses.he: בָּתַר דְּיִזְדַּבַּן פֻּרְקָנָא תְּהֵי לֵיהּ חַד מֵאֲחוֹהִי יִפְרְקִנֵּיהּ:
verses.en: After he is sold redemption shall be his, one of his bretheren shall redeem him.

verses.he: אוֹ אַח אֲבוּהִי אוֹ בַר אַח אֲבוּהִי יִפְרְקִנֵּיהּ אוֹ מִקָּרִיב בִּשְׂרֵיהּ מִזַּרְעִיתֵיהּ יִפְרְקִנֵּיהּ אוֹ דְתַדְבֵּק יְדֵיהּ וְיִתְפָּרָק:
verses.en: Either his uncle [father’s brother] or his uncles son [the son of his father’s brother] (cousin) shall redeem him or the closest (other) family relative shall redeem him. If he obtains sufficient means of his own he may be redeemed [on his own.]

verses.he: וִיחַשֵּׁב עִם זָבְנֵיהּ מִשַּׁתָּא דְּאִזְדַּבַּן לֵיהּ עַד שַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא וִיהֵי כְּסַף זְבִינוֹהִי בְּמִנְיַן שְׁנַיָא כְּיוֹמֵי אֲגִירָא יְהֵי עִמֵּיהּ:
verses.en: He shall reckon with the one who bought him. [According to the number of years] from the year which he was sold to him until the jubilee year. His purchase price shall be [proportional] to the number of years; at the rate of the days of a hired hand it shall be [considered as he worked] with him.

verses.he: אִם עוֹד סְגִיּוּת בִּשְׁנַיָּא לְפוּמְהֵן יָתֵיב פֻּרְקָנֵיהּ מִכְּסַף זְבִינוֹהִי:
verses.en: If there are yet many years [until the jubilee] accordingly shall he return his redemption money from his purchase price.

verses.he: וְאִם זְעֵר יִשְׁתָּאַר בִּשְׁנַיָּא עַד שַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא וִיחַשֵּׁב לֵיהּ כְּפוּם שְׁנוֹהִי יָתֵב יָת פֻּרְקָנֵיהּ:
verses.en: If there remain but a few years until the jubilee year, he shall make a [similar] calculation, based on the number of years he shall return his redemption money [to the purchaser.]

verses.he: כַּאֲגִיר שְׁנָא בִּשְׁנָא יְהֵי עִמֵּיהּ לָא יִפְלַח בֵּיהּ בְּקַשְׁיוּ לְעֵינָיךְ:
verses.en: As a hired hand [working] on a yearly basis shall he be considered with him; he shall not rule over him [make him work] to crush him before your eyes.

verses.he: וְאִם לָא יִתְפָּרַק בְּאִלֵּין וְיִפּוֹק בְּשַׁתָּא דְיוֹבֵלָא הוּא וּבְנוֹהִי עִמֵּיהּ:
verses.en: If he is not redeemed through these means he then goes out in the jubilee year, he, along with his children.

verses.he: אֲרֵי דִילִי בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדִּין עַבְדַּי אִנּוּן דִּי אֲפֵּיקִית יָתְהוֹן מֵאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: For, Bnei Yisroel are My servants. They are My servants whom I have brought out of the land of Egypt, I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: לָא תַעְבְּדוּן לְכוֹן טַעֲוָן וְצֶלֶם וְקָמָא לָא תְקִימוּן לְכוֹן וְאֶבֶן סָגְדָא לָא תִתְּנוּן בְּאַרְעֲכוֹן לְמִסְגֻּד עֲלַהּ אֲרֵי אֲנָא יְיָ אֱלָהָכוֹן:
verses.en: You shall not make [false] idols for yourselves and graven images and memorial stones you shall not raise up for youselves, and a prostration stone you shall not set in your land upon which to prostrate oneself, for I am Adonoy, your God.

verses.he: יָת יוֹמֵי שַׁבַּיָּא דִילִי תִטְּרוּן וּלְבֵית מַקְדְּשִׁי תְּהוֹן דָּחֲלִין אֲנָא יְיָ:
verses.en: You shall keep [the days of] My Shabbosos and you shall fear (revere) [the House of] My Sanctuary, I am Adonoy.
